blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision–Language–Action (VLA) models have achieved impressive results in robotic manipulation and ground-mobile navigation, yet language-conditioned control of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in smart warehouses remains largely unexplored. Progress is hindered by the lack of benchmarks that jointly provide continuous low-level flight actions, fine-grained natural-language target descriptions and realistic industrial environments. This paper introduces WareFly-VLA, a photorealistic UAV VLA framework and dataset for language-guided human search, localization and tracking in intra-logistics and warehouse environments. The dataset contains 507 human-teleoperated flight episodes and 8,504 non-terminal high-resolution RGB transitions collected in NVIDIA Isaac Sim; each transition is paired with a human-written appearance description of the target worker and a synchronized four-degree-of-freedom control command comprising translational and yaw changes. Two aerial embodied tasks are covered, target approach and person following, under realistic challenges including occlusion, long-range search, altitude variation and clutter. A unified benchmark of four representative open-source VLA architectures (SmolVLA, GR00T N1.7, π 0 \pi_{0} and OpenVLA) is established under a leakage-free episode-level protocol at two control rates. The results show that language-conditioned aerial control in warehouses remains far from solved: performance drops substantially under strict generalization settings, continuous action modeling consistently outperforms discrete action tokenization, only the forward channel is reliably learnable from a single frame, and current foundation-model interfaces transfer poorly from ground and humanoid embodiments to aerial platforms. The synchronized video, language, action, pose and difficulty annotations further support world-model research. The dataset, baselines and evaluation protocol are released to support language-grounded aerial autonomy in smart warehouses.
blocks.zh: 远景-语言-行动(VLA)模型在机器人操纵和地上-机动导航方面取得了令人印象深刻的成果,但智能仓库中无人驾驶飞行器(UAVs)在语言条件下的控制基本上仍未被探索. 由于缺乏共同提供持续低水平飞行行动、精细自然语言目标描述和现实工业环境的基准,进展受阻。 本文介绍了WareFly-VLA,这是一个光现实主义的UAV VLA框架和数据集,用于语言指导的人类搜索,本地化和跟踪在物流内部和仓库环境中. 该数据集收录了NVIDIA Isaac Sim所收集的507个人-远程操作飞行事件和8,504个非地心高分辨率RGB过渡;每次过渡都配有目标工人的人文外观描述和由翻译和yaw变化组成的同步四度自由控制指令. 在实际的挑战下,包括隔离、远程搜索、高度变化和杂乱无章地,完成了两项航空任务、目标方法和人员跟踪。 由四个有代表性的开源VLA架构(SmolVLA,GR00T N1.7,π0\pi_{0}和OpenVLA)构成的统一基准,在一个无渗漏的插曲级协议下以两个控制速率建立. 结果显示,仓库中语言条件的空中控制还远远没有解决:在严格的通用化环境下,性能大幅下降;连续的动作模型持续地超过离散动作符号化;只有前方通道能够可靠地从一个框架学习;目前的地基模型界面从地面和人造地表向空中平台的转移很差。 同步视频,语言,动作,姿势和难度说明进一步支持了世界模式研究. 发布数据集、基线和评价协议,以支持智能仓库中基于语言的航空自主权。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A long-standing objective of embodied artificial intelligence is to enable robots to interpret natural-language instructions, ground them in visual observations and execute appropriate low-level actions in dynamic environments. Recent Vision–Language–Action (VLA) models such as PaLM-E [ 13 ] , RT-1 [ 8 ] , RT-2 [ 7 ] , Octo [ 16 ] , OpenVLA [ 27 ] , RDT-1B [ 31 ] , π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 6 ] , SmolVLA [ 43 ] , TinyVLA [ 51 ] and Qwen-VLA [ 47 ] have demonstrated that large-scale multimodal training can produce policies that generalize across tasks, environments and robot embodiments. These advances suggest that a unified perception–language–control paradigm may provide a scalable foundation for future autonomous systems.
blocks.zh: 包含人工智能的一个长期目标是使机器人能够解释自然语言指令,在视觉观察中将其定位,并在动态环境中执行适当的低等动作. 近期愿景-语言-行动(VLA)模式,如PALM-E [13],RT-1 [8],RT-2 [7],Octo [16],OpenVLA [27],RDT-1B [31], ^ 0.5\pi_{0.5} [6], SmolVLA [43], TinyVLA [51] 和 Quen-VLA [47] 都表明,大规模多模式培训可以产生跨越任务,环境和机器人的平面化政策. 这些进步表明,统一的认知-语言-控制范式可为未来的自主系统提供可扩展的基础。

blocks.en: Despite rapid progress, contemporary VLA research remains heavily concentrated on robotic manipulation and ground-mobile platforms. Large-scale datasets and benchmarks predominantly focus on tabletop manipulation, mobile navigation or humanoid interaction, whereas aerial robots remain significantly underrepresented, even though vision-based control of multi-rotor aerial vehicles is a mature and active research area [ 35 ] . This gap is particularly notable because unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) present a distinct embodiment with substantially different sensing, motion and control characteristics. Being different from manipulators that operate within constrained workspaces or ground robots that navigate primarily in two dimensions, UAVs perform continuous motion in three-dimensional space while simultaneously regulating position, altitude and heading. Visual observations are highly dynamic due to rapid viewpoint changes, target scale variation and frequent occlusions. Consequently, transferring VLA paradigms developed for ground or manipulation settings to aerial systems is far from straightforward.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了迅速进展,但当代VLA的研究仍然高度集中于机器人操纵和地动平台. 大型数据集和基准主要侧重于平板电脑操纵,移动导航或人机交互,而航空机器人仍然代表率相去甚远,尽管基于视觉的多旋转飞行器控制是一个成熟而活跃的研究领域[35]. 这一差距特别明显,因为无人驾驶飞行器具有明显的不同感知、运动和控制特性。 与在受限制的工作空间内操作的操纵器或主要以两个维度导航的地面机器人不同,无人机在三维空间中进行连续运动,同时调节位置,高度和航向. 由于视野变化快,目标尺度变异和经常被遮住,视觉观测非常活泼. 因此,将为地面或操纵环境开发的志愿军模式转移到航空系统远非直截了当。

blocks.en: Among the many tasks relevant to aerial autonomy, language-guided human search and following represents a particularly compelling benchmark for embodied intelligence. Consider the instruction: “Track the worker wearing a yellow hard hat and a purple safety vest.” Successfully executing this command requires the integration of multiple capabilities. The UAV must first interpret fine-grained appearance descriptions, identify the correct individual among visually similar distractors, actively search when the target is not immediately visible, maintain target association over time and continuously generate flight-control commands that ensure safe and reliable tracking. In contrast to conventional UAV tracking benchmarks, where the target is initialized through a bounding box or visual template, language-guided following requires semantic target specification and persistent multimodal grounding throughout the entire trajectory. This setting naturally combines visual grounding, embodied language understanding, active perception and continuous control within a single task.
blocks.zh: 在与航空自主有关的许多任务中,语言指导的人类搜索和跟踪是体现情报的一个特别令人信服的基准。 考虑以下指示:“追踪身穿黄色硬帽和紫色安全背心的工人。” 成功执行这个指令需要整合多个能力. 无人机必须首先解释精细的外观描述,在视觉相近的分光器中识别出正确的个体,在目标无法即时被看到时积极搜索,随着时间的推移保持目标关联,并不断生成能确保安全可靠的跟踪的飞行控制指令. 与传统的无人驾驶飞行器跟踪基准不同,在目标通过边框或可视模板初始化的情况下,语言指导遵循要求语义性目标规格和在整个轨道上持续多模式地平线。 这种设置自然结合了视觉地基,体现语言理解,积极感知和在一个任务中的连续控制.

blocks.en: Existing datasets do not adequately support this problem formulation. Classical approaches such as Chen et al. [ 10 ] , aerial tracking benchmarks such as UAV123 [ 33 ] , and subsequent UAV tracking datasets [ 53 ] provide extensive flight recordings but rely exclusively on visual target initialization without language supervision. Vision-language navigation datasets such as AerialVLN [ 30 ] , AirNav [ 12 ] , EmbodiedCity [ 52 ] , UAV-VLN [ 48 ] and GeoText-1652 [ 32 ] introduced natural-language instructions but formulated navigation primarily as waypoint prediction or route planning rather than continuous low-level control. In a similar vein, large-scale drone footage datasets exist and are used to extract ground vehicle trajectories for driving research [ 50 ] ; however, the lack of ergo-centric controls makes them unsuitable for aerial embodied AI. Recent UAV-oriented VLA datasets and benchmarks remain limited in scope. CognitiveDrone [ 34 ] focused on simulation-based trajectory generation. UAV-VLA [ 41 ] targets mission-level reasoning from aerial imagery and RaceVLA [ 42 ] addressed drone-racing policies. Although these resources have advanced aerial embodied learning, none simultaneously provide appearance-grounded language descriptions, continuous flight-control supervision, human-demonstrated trajectories and warehouse-scale person-search-and-follow tasks.
blocks.zh: 现有的数据集不足以支持这一问题的拟订。 陈等经典取法. [10],空中跟踪基准如UAV123 [33],以及随后的无人机跟踪数据集[53]提供了广泛的飞行录音,但完全依靠可视目标初始化而无需语言监督. AirVLN [30],AirNav [12],EmbodyCity [52],UAV-VLN [48]和GeoText-1652 [32]等远景语言导航数据集引入了自然语言指令,但制定导航主要作为出站点预测或航道规划,而不是持续的低水平控制. 类似地,大型无人机相机相机的相机相机数据集存在并被用于提取地面车辆行驶轨迹来驱动研究[50];然而,缺乏以ergo为中心的控制使得它们不适合航空所体现AI. 最近面向无人驾驶飞行器的甚高频数据集和基准的范围仍然有限。 认知Drone [34] 专注于基于模拟的轨迹生成. UAV-VLA[41]针对的是从航空图像和RaceVLA[42]的飞行任务层面推理,涉及无人机追踪政策. 尽管这些资源具有先进的航空内涵学习,但没有一种资源同时提供外观语言描述、持续的飞行控制监督、人文演示的轨迹和仓库规模的个人搜索和跟踪任务。

blocks.en: To address this limitation, this paper introduces WareFly-VLA , a Vision–Language–Action dataset for language-guided human search and following in industrial warehouse environments. The dataset is collected from human-teleoperated UAV demonstrations performed in a photorealistic warehouse environment constructed in NVIDIA Isaac Sim. Each trajectory contains synchronized high-resolution RGB observations, fine-grained appearance-based language descriptions and continuous 4-DoF flight actions represented as body-frame motion commands. In contrast to scripted navigation policies or automatically generated expert trajectories, the dataset captures realistic human decision-making behaviors during target search, target acquisition and continuous following. The resulting trajectories naturally include recovery maneuvers, viewpoint adaptation, target re-identification and other behaviors that commonly arise during practical aerial operation.
blocks.zh: 为解决这一限制,本文介绍了WareFly-VLA,这是一个用于在工业仓库环境中进行语言指导的人类搜索和跟踪的远景-语言-行动数据集。 数据集是在由NVIDIA Isaac Sim建造的一具光现实主义仓库环境中,从人类操作的无人驾驶航空器演示中收集的。 每个轨迹都包含同步高分辨率的RGB观测,精细外观的外观语言描述和连续4-DoF飞行动作作为机身-帧运动指令来表示. 与脚本导航政策或自动生成专家轨迹形成对比的是,数据集在目标搜索,目标获取和接续过程中捕捉现实的人类决策行为. 由此产生的轨迹自然包括恢复操作、视线调整、目标再识别以及在实际空中行动期间常见的其他行为。

blocks.en: WareFly-VLA is designed around two complementary embodied tasks: approach-and-locate and person-following . The dataset further incorporates diverse warehouse layouts, worker appearances, target distances, altitude changes, partial occlusions and cluttered industrial environments. Structured difficulty annotations enable systematic evaluation across multiple challenge dimensions and support future research on generalization, robustness and language grounding under realistic operating conditions.
blocks.zh: WareFly-VLA的设计围绕两个相辅相成的任务:方法与定位和人跟随。 数据集进一步融入了不同的仓库布局,工人外观,目标距离,高度变化,部分隐蔽和杂乱的工业环境. 结构化的困难说明有助于对多个挑战层面进行系统评价,并支持今后在现实运作条件下对通用性、稳健性和语言基础的研究。

blocks.en: Beyond dataset construction, a unified benchmark is established to evaluate representative open-source VLA architectures using a common leakage-free episode-level split. The benchmark spans multiple model families and action-representation paradigms, providing a standardized framework for studying aerial embodied intelligence. Experimental results indicate that language-conditioned UAV control remains a challenging open problem, highlighting substantial opportunities for future advances in multimodal representation learning, continuous action prediction and cross-embodiment transfer.
blocks.zh: 除了数据集构建外,还建立了一个统一的基准,以使用常见的无渗漏插曲平分法来评价有代表性的开源VLA架构. 该基准涵盖多个模范家庭和行动代表范式,为研究航空内含情报提供了一个标准化框架。 实验结果表明,基于语言条件的无人驾驶飞行器控制仍然是一个具有挑战性的公开问题,突出了今后在多式联运表现学习、持续行动预测和交叉表现转移方面取得进展的大量机会。

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are as follows:
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: 1. WareFly-VLA , a human-teleoperated UAV Vision–Language–Action dataset for language-guided human search and following in warehouse environments, containing synchronized visual observations, appearance-grounded language descriptions and continuous 4-DoF flight actions. 2. A human-demonstration data collection pipeline built in NVIDIA Isaac Sim that captures realistic aerial search, target localization, target acquisition and continuously following behaviors from teleoperated quadrotor trajectories. 3. Aerial embodied benchmark tasks covering approach-and-locate and person-following scenarios under realistic challenges, including occlusion, altitude variation, long-range search, viewpoint changes and cluttered industrial environments. 4. A unified aerial VLA benchmark for evaluating representative open-source VLA architectures under a standardized leakage-free evaluation protocol. 5. An open-source research platform including dataset artifacts, benchmark configurations, training pipelines and evaluation tools to facilitate future research on aerial embodied intelligence, language-grounded UAV autonomy and Vision–Language–Action learning. 6. Open world-model research directions enabled by WareFly-VLA, including predictive representation learning, action-conditioned latent dynamics, language-conditioned planning and sim-to-real transfer for aerial embodied intelligence.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Vision–Language–Action models
blocks.zh: 2.1 远景-语言-行动模式

blocks.en: VLA models have emerged as a unified paradigm for embodied intelligence by jointly learning perception, language understanding and control. Early efforts such as PaLM-E [ 13 ] demonstrated the feasibility of integrating visual observations into large language models for robotic decision making. Subsequent systems including RT-1 [ 8 ] , RT-2 [ 7 ] , Open X-Embodiment [ 39 ] , Octo [ 16 ] , OpenVLA [ 27 ] , RDT-1B [ 31 ] , π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 6 ] , SmolVLA [ 43 ] , TinyVLA [ 51 ] and Qwen-VLA [ 47 ] have demonstrated increasingly strong generalization across tasks, environments and robotic embodiments.
blocks.zh: VLA模型通过共同学习感知,语言理解和控制,成为体现智能的统一范式. PaLM-E [13]等早期的努力证明了将视觉观测纳入大型语言模型用于机器人决策的可行性. 随后的系统包括RT-1 [8],RT-2 [7],Open X-Embodiment [39],Octo [16],OpenVLA [27],RDT-1B [31],π 0.5\pi_{0.5] [6], SmolVLA [43],TinyVLA [51]和Quen-VLA [47] 都表现出日益强烈的跨任务,跨环境和机器人化的概括.

blocks.en: Recent research has further explored large-scale pretraining and cross-embodiment transfer. Open X-Embodiment [ 39 ] aggregated demonstrations from multiple robot platforms to investigate shared policy learning, while OpenVLA [ 27 ] , RDT-1B [ 31 ] and π 0 \pi_{0} [ 5 ] explored foundation-model approaches capable of adapting to diverse downstream tasks. Inference-time policy steering has further been proposed to deploy pre-trained VLAs on new tasks without fine-tuning [ 29 ] . Despite these advances, the overwhelming majority of VLA benchmarks remain centered on robotic manipulation, mobile navigation and humanoid control. The applicability of VLA models to aerial robots remains comparatively underexplored, largely due to the scarcity of UAV-specific datasets that combine language instructions with continuous flight-control supervision.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究进一步探索了大规模预训和跨化转移. Open X-Embodiment [39] 汇总多个机器人平台的演示以调查共享政策学习,而OpenVLA [27],RDT-1B [31]和 ^0\pi_{0} [5] 探索能够适应多样下游任务的基础-模型方法. 还进一步提议,在不作微调的情况下就新任务部署经过预先培训的志愿军部队。 尽管取得了这些进展,但绝大多数的VLA基准仍以机器人操纵、移动导航和人文控制为中心。 VLA模型对航空机器人的可应用性仍然相对未得到充分的探索,这主要是由于UAV特定数据集的稀缺性,这些数据集将语言指令与持续的飞行控制监督相结合.

blocks.en: 2.2 Language-grounded aerial navigation
blocks.zh: 2.2 基于语言的空中导航

blocks.en: Language-guided navigation has become an important benchmark for embodied intelligence, motivating a growing body of research on aerial vision-language systems. AerialVLN [ 30 ] introduced a large-scale simulation benchmark for instruction-following UAV navigation. Subsequent efforts expanded this direction through more realistic environments and richer navigation objectives, including UAV-VLN [ 48 ] , EmbodiedCity [ 52 ] , GeoText-1652 [ 32 ] , AirNav [ 12 ] and semantic-topometric aerial navigation frameworks [ 15 ] . Additional studies have investigated aerial dialogue navigation and interactive instruction following [ 14 ] , and vision-language policies for onboard drone navigation have been trained in radiance-field simulators [ 11 ] . In parallel, learning-based vision-driven following behaviors for UAVs, such as safe river following via reinforcement learning with a semantic dynamics model [ 49 ] , show that end-to-end visual control of aerial platforms is feasible, but they do not involve language-specified targets.
blocks.zh: 语言导航已成为体现智能的重要基准,激发了越来越多的航空视觉语言系统研究。 AirVLN [30] 引入了用于指令跟随无人机导航的大规模模拟基准. 其后的努力通过更现实的环境和更丰富的导航目标来扩大这一方向,包括无人驾驶飞行器-VLN[48]、健美城市[52]、GeoText-1652 [32]、AirNav[12]和语义-对称航空导航框架[15]。 更多的研究调查了空中对话导航和[14]之后的交互式教学,对无人驾驶飞机导航的视觉语言政策进行了辐射-场模拟器的培训[11]。 同时,基于学习的视觉驱动对无人驾驶飞行器的跟踪行为,如通过语义动力学模型的强化学习来跟踪安全河流[49],表明对航空平台的端到端视觉控制是可行的,但并不涉及语言特定的目标.

blocks.en: These datasets have significantly advanced aerial language grounding and instruction-conditioned navigation. However, most methods formulate navigation as waypoint prediction, route planning or localization rather than direct low-level control. As a result, they provide limited supervision for end-to-end VLA learning, where language instructions must be translated directly into continuous flight actions.
blocks.zh: 这些数据集具有显著的先进航空语言地平线和有指令条件的导航. 然而,大多数方法将导航形成为指向点预测,路线规划或本地化,而不是直接的低等控制. 因此,它们为从一端到一端的VLA学习提供了有限的监督,语言指令必须被直接转化为连续飞行动作.

blocks.en: 2.3 UAV VLA datasets and benchmarks
blocks.zh: 2.3 无人驾驶飞行器VLA数据集和基准

blocks.en: Recent studies have begun extending the Vision–Language–Action paradigm to aerial robotics. UAV-VLA [ 41 ] investigates mission-level planning and reasoning from aerial imagery, while RaceVLA [ 42 ] explores language-conditioned drone-racing policies derived from OpenVLA. CognitiveDrone [ 34 ] combines VLA policies with reasoning-oriented VLMs for simulation-based cognitive UAV navigation. Broader surveys have also highlighted the growing role of foundation models and LLMs in UAV autonomy [ 44 ] .
blocks.zh: 最近的研究开始将视野-语言-行动范式扩展到航空机器人。 UAV-VLA [41] 调查从航空图像中得出的任务级别规划和推理,而RaceVLA [42] 探索从OpenVLA衍生出的语言条件化无人机追逐政策. Cognitive Drone [34] 将VLA政策与以推理为导向的VLM结合,用于以模拟为基础的认知UAV导航. 更广泛的调查还突出了基础模型和有限责任公司在无人驾驶航空器自主权方面日益重要的作用[44]。

blocks.en: Although these efforts demonstrate the promise of foundation-model-based aerial autonomy, important limitations remain. Existing benchmarks are typically restricted to racing, navigation, mission planning or simulation-specific tasks. Many datasets rely on automatically generated trajectories or task-specific objectives that do not require semantic target grounding. Furthermore, appearance-based human search and following has received little attention within the UAV VLA literature.
blocks.zh: 虽然这些努力表明有希望实现基于基础模型的航空自主,但仍然存在重要的局限性。 现有基准一般限于赛跑,导航,任务规划或模拟特定任务. 许多数据集依赖于自动生成的轨迹或任务特定目标,这些目的不需要语义目标地面. 此外,基于外观的人类搜索和跟踪在无人机VLA文献中很少受到关注。

blocks.en: Consequently, there remains no publicly available benchmark that simultaneously provides appearance-grounded natural-language target descriptions, continuous 4-DoF flight-control actions, human-teleoperated UAV demonstrations and language-guided human search-and-follow tasks in realistic warehouse environments. WareFly-VLA is designed to fill this gap and to provide a dedicated benchmark for aerial Vision–Language–Action learning.
blocks.zh: 因此,仍然没有公开的基准同时提供基于外观的自然语言目标描述、连续的4-DoF飞行控制行动、人类操作的无人驾驶飞行器演示以及现实仓库环境中的语言指导人类搜索和跟踪任务。 WareFly-VLA旨在填补这一空白,并为空中视野-语言-行动学习提供专门基准。

blocks.en: 3 The WareFly-VLA dataset
blocks.zh: 3个 WareFly-VLA 数据集

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset design principles
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集设计原则

blocks.en: WareFly-VLA is designed around a central objective: enabling research on language-guided human search and following for aerial robots. In contrast to conventional UAV tracking benchmarks that require explicit target initialization via bounding boxes or visual templates, WareFly-VLA specifies the target exclusively through natural-language descriptions of observable appearance attributes. Consequently, successful task completion requires the integration of language grounding, visual identification, active search, target re-identification and continuous flight control.
blocks.zh: WareFly-VLA的设计围绕一个中心目标:能够对语言引导的人类搜索进行研究并跟踪航空机器人. 与常规的无人驾驶飞行器跟踪基准不同,这些基准要求通过边框或视觉模板明确目标初始化,WareFly-VLA完全通过对可观测外观属性的自然语言描述来指定目标. 因此,要成功完成任务,就必须将语言定位、视觉识别、主动搜索、目标再识别和连续飞行控制结合起来。

blocks.en: Three design principles guided the dataset construction process. Firstly, all trajectories are generated from human-teleoperated demonstrations rather than scripted controllers, allowing the dataset to capture realistic search and following behaviors. Secondly, language annotations emphasize appearance-based target grounding instead of spatial instructions, reflecting realistic warehouse deployment scenarios. Thirdly, the dataset focuses on continuous low-level flight actions, making it suitable for Vision–Language–Action learning rather than high-level navigation alone.
blocks.zh: 3个设计原则指导了数据集建设过程. 首先,所有轨迹都是由人类-远程操作的演示产生的,而不是由脚本控制器产生的,使得数据集能够捕捉现实的搜索并跟踪行为. 第二,语言说明强调基于外观的目标搁浅,而不是空间指示,反映现实的仓库部署情况。 第三,数据集侧重于持续的低水平飞行动作,使其适合Vision–Language–Action学习,而不只是高水平导航.

blocks.en: 3.2 Simulation environment
blocks.zh: 3.2 模拟环境

blocks.en: Data collection is implemented in Pegasus Simulator [ 23 ] , a framework for simulating drone dynamics built as an extension to NVIDIA Isaac Sim [ 36 ] , a photorealistic and physically based robotics simulation platform. The environment consists of a large industrial warehouse containing shelving racks, conveyor systems, forklift lanes, storage areas and mixed lighting conditions. The scene is intentionally designed to expose the UAV to realistic visual challenges, including clutter, repetitive textures, reflective surfaces, viewpoint changes and partial occlusions. A simulated quadrotor equipped with a forward-facing RGB camera captures observations at 1920 × 1440 1920\times 1440 pixels. Ground-truth vehicle pose is obtained directly from the simulator state, providing accurate position and orientation measurements throughout each trajectory.
blocks.zh: 数据收集在Pegasus模拟器[23]中实施,这个模拟无人机动态的框架是作为NVIDIA Isaac Sim [36]的扩展而建立的,是一个光现实性和以物理为基础的机器人模拟平台. 环境由一大型工业仓库组成,仓库内有壳架,输送系统,叉车道,储存地和混合照明条件. 该场景有意让无人机面临现实的视觉挑战,包括杂乱无章地,重复的纹理,反射地表,观点变化和部分被隔离等. 一个安装有前向RGB相机的模拟四相机在1920×1440 1920\times 1440像素时捕获观测. 地面真实飞行器姿势直接取自模拟状态,在每个轨道上提供准确的位置和方向测量。

blocks.en: 3.3 Human-Teleoperated Data Collection
blocks.zh: 3.3 人类运营 数据收集

blocks.en: Each episode begins by assigning a worker a unique combination of clothing and personal protective equipment (PPE), including safety vests, hard hats, shirts, overalls, pants, gloves and other accessories. Appearance configurations are intentionally diversified to maximize language grounding diversity and minimize attribute overlap between episodes.
blocks.zh: 每一集开头都为工人分配了一套独特的服装和个人防护设备(PPE),包括安全背心,硬帽,衬衫,上衣,裤子,手套等配件. 外观配置有意多样化,以尽量扩大语言基础的多样性并尽量减少各集之间的属性重叠.

blocks.en: A human operator teleoperates the UAV while attempting to locate, approach and follow the designated target worker. The target follows a predefined route unknown to the operator, requiring continuous visual search and target maintenance throughout the trajectory. This setup naturally produces realistic aerial behaviors, including target acquisition, viewpoint adjustment, temporary target loss, recovery maneuvers and continuous following.
blocks.zh: 人类操作人员在试图找到、接近和跟踪指定的目标工人时,可以远程操作无人驾驶航空器。 目标遵循的是操作员未知的预设路线,需要在整个轨迹中持续进行视觉搜索并进行目标维护. 这种设置自然会产生现实的航空行为,包括目标获取,视点调整,临时目标丢失,回收操作和连续跟踪.

blocks.en: All RGB observations, control inputs and simulator states are recorded synchronously. The resulting trajectories form a collection of human-demonstrated aerial embodied behaviors suitable for Vision–Language–Action learning.
blocks.zh: 所有RGB观测,控制输入和模拟状态都是同步记录的. 由此形成的轨迹形成了一套人类演示的航空所包含行为,适合视觉-语言-行动学习。

blocks.en:
To reduce redundancy while preserving meaningful control dynamics, the
recorded streams are temporally subsampled to 1 1 FPS, consistent with the effective decision frequencies commonly adopted in recent VLA
systems [ 5 , 27 ] .
blocks.zh:
为了减少冗余,同时保留有意义的控制动态,
记录流在时间上被取样为1个FPS,这符合最近VLA中通常采用的有效决定频率
[5、27]。

blocks.en: 3.4 Teleoperation policy
blocks.zh: 3.4 电信业务政策

blocks.en: To produce trajectories that are diverse in scene yet consistent in behavior, the human pilot follows a deliberately deterministic search–decide–approach policy. Fig. 1 summarises the policy as a finite-state machine with three search states, one decision, one goal-directed action state and an absorbing terminal state.
blocks.zh: 人类飞行员为了制造场景各异的轨迹, 图1总结了这个政策,它是一个有限度的状态机器,有三个搜索状态,一个决定,一个目标定向动作状态和一个吸收终端状态.

blocks.en: Look Around. Every episode begins with the pilot performing a yaw 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} sweep in place. The sweep is a rotation-only maneuver around the drone’s initial position. It enables target acquisition within the camera’s effective field of view at the current altitude without committing the drone to a specific motion direction.
blocks.zh: 看看周围 每个剧集都从飞行员开始 演绎出一个"Yaw 360" 360"circ"的扫地出场. 无人机最初位置上, 它可以在摄像头的有效视野内获得目标,

blocks.en: check_open decision. If the sweep completes without acquiring the target, the pilot consults a binary state-of-environment check. When the drone is currently in an open area (sufficient lateral clearance to fly between shelving rows), control proceeds to Scan Shelves . When the drone is in an aisle or back-space (constrained by walls or rack ends), control proceeds to Move to Open .
blocks.zh: 检查_打开决定。 如果扫射未获得目标而完成,飞行员会查询二进制环境状态检查. 当无人机目前处于一片空地(有足够的横向许可可在雪平行间飞行)时,控制开始于Scan Shelves. 当无人机处于过道或后空地(被墙或架尾所束缚)时,控制开始移动到Open.

blocks.en: Scan Shelves. In this state the pilot flies to the edge of the closest shelving row, angles the drone outward by approximately 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} and traverses parallel to the row while looking down each aisle in turn. This pattern systematically sweeps the only volume that the in-place yaw cannot reach the deep interior of shelving aisles and is the dominant source of large lateral Δ ​ y ℓ \Delta y_{\ell} commands in the corpus.
blocks.zh: 扫描谢尔维斯。 在这个状态下,飞行员飞到最靠近起落架的一行的边缘,将无人机向外取出约45分之45分之45分之45分之45分之45分之45分之45分之45分之45分之45分之45分之45分之45分之45分之45分之45分之45分之45分之45分之45分之45分相向外仰望每个过道。 这种图案系统地扫荡了现场的yaw无法到达雪地道深处的唯一的体积,并且是主力来源于大型的平面  y y / i / Delta y_{\ell / 在被体中命令.

blocks.en: Move to Open. When the drone is hemmed in by infrastructure, the pilot first repositions to a viewpoint with broader lateral clearance, flying toward the nearest open area and continuing to look for an appearance-matching target along the way. Once the drone arrives, the state machine loops back to Look Around so that a full sweep can be executed from a more advantageous viewpoint.
blocks.zh: 移动到 Open 。 当无人机受到基础设施的冲击时,飞行员首先重新定位到一个具有更广泛横向清除的视角,飞向最近的空地并沿途继续寻找外观匹配的目标. 一旦无人机到达 国家机器就会回转到Look Around 这样就可以从更有利的角度进行全扫

blocks.en: Approach Target. As soon as the target appears in the camera frame from any of the three search states, the pilot transitions to the goal-directed Approach Target state, yaws to center the target in the frame, and flies toward it. The episode terminates on Reached Target .
blocks.zh: 接近目标 一旦目标从三个搜索州中任何一个的相机帧中出现,飞行员就向目标定向目标状态过渡,向目标在帧中以中心为中心而行走并飞向它. 剧集在"达到目标"上结束.

blocks.en: Search-exhaustion loops. A Scan Shelves pass that completes without acquisition raises a Search Exhausted transition back to Look Around and a Move to Open pass that arrives at the new viewpoint without acquisition raises an analogous Arrived at open area transition. The policy therefore guarantees that the drone always returns to a yaw-sweep state between unsuccessful search legs, rather than chaining multiple action states blindly.
blocks.zh: 搜索耗尽的循环。 一个Scan Shelves通过一个没有获得而完成的Scan Shelves使搜索耗尽的过渡回到了Look Around,一个没有获得而到达了新观点的Scan Shelves通过一个在开放地区过渡的类似到达。 因此,政策保证无人机总是在搜索失败的两条腿之间回落为yaw-sweep状态,而不是盲目地连锁多个动作状态.

blocks.en: Figure 1: State-transition diagram of the human teleoperation policy used during data collection. Search states ( Look Around , Scan Shelves and Move to Open ) are shown in cyan. The check_open decision node is shown in amber, and the goal-directed Approach Target state is shown in green. From any search state, detecting the target in the camera frame triggers an immediate transition to Approach Target . If Scan Shelves ends with Search Exhausted , or if Move to Open ends with Arrived at open area , the policy returns to Look Around . The episode terminates when the drone reaches the target.

blocks.en: Why a deterministic policy. Fixing the high-level behavior while randomizing warehouse layout, target route and target appearance configuration produces a corpus that is behaviourally consistent every episode contains the same acquisition–closure–tracking phases while remaining trajectory-wise diverse , with varied path shapes, distances, durations and occlusion patterns (Fig. 3 ). This combination is what allows the 507-episode corpus to discriminate sharply between modern VLA architectures despite its modest scale (Sections 5 – 6 ) and it directly motivates the difficulty-tag axes used for stratified evaluation (Section 4 ).
blocks.zh: 为什么是决定性政策? 修正高层次的行为,同时随机地将仓库布局,目标路线和目标外观配置产生一个行为上一致的元件,每集包含相同的获取-关闭-跟踪阶段,同时保持轨迹上的多样性,具有不同的路径形状,距离,持续时间和隔离模式(图3). 这种组合使得507-集成体尽管规模不大(第5至6节),但仍能在现代的VLA架构中进行尖锐的区分,直接激发用于分层评价的难度-立方轴(第4节)。

blocks.en: 3.6 Language annotation
blocks.zh: 3.6 语言注释

blocks.en: Following trajectory collection, each episode is independently annotated by human annotators from the perspective of a remote UAV operator. Instructions describe the target exclusively through observable appearance attributes, including clothing, colors, accessories, and personal protective equipment (PPE), while avoiding identity information or scene-specific positional references. Multiple paraphrases are provided to increase linguistic diversity and improve robustness to instruction variations. All annotations undergo secondary review to ensure factual consistency and language quality, resulting in an appearance-centric language corpus specifically designed for language-guided human search and following.
blocks.zh: 在轨迹收集之后,每集都由人类注释员从远程无人驾驶航空器操作员的角度独立注释. 指令完全通过可观察到的外观属性来描述目标,包括衣物,颜色,附件,以及个人防护设备(PPE),同时避免身份信息或特定场景的位置参考. 为增加语言多样性和提高教学变异的稳健性,提供了多段语句. 所有说明都经过二次审查,以确保事实一致性和语言质量,从而形成一个以外观为中心的语言体,专门设计用于语言指导的人类搜索和跟踪。

blocks.en: 5.1 Benchmark models
blocks.zh: 5.1 基准模型

blocks.en: A primary objective of WareFly-VLA is to provide a standardized benchmark for evaluating Vision–Language–Action learning in aerial environments. To this end, four representative open-source VLA architectures are selected: OpenVLA-7B [ 27 ] , GR00T N1.7 [ 38 ] , π 0 \pi_{0} /OpenPI [ 5 ] and SmolVLA [ 43 ] . These models collectively span the three dominant action-generation paradigms currently used in VLA systems, namely discrete action tokenization, diffusion-based action generation and flow matching. They further cover a broad range of parameter scales and embodiment assumptions, providing a diverse testbed for studying aerial transfer and language-conditioned UAV control. Table 4 summarizes the benchmarked architecture used for fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: WareFly-VLA的一个主要目标是为评价空中环境中的Vision-Language-Action学习提供标准基准。 为此,选择了四个有代表性的开源VLA架构:OpenVLA-7B [27],GR00T N1.7 [38], 0\pi_{0}/OpenPI [5]和SmolVLA [43]. 这些模型共同跨越了VLA系统中目前使用的三大主要动作生成范式,即离散动作符号化,以扩散为基础的动作生成和流量匹配. 它们还涵盖广泛的参数尺度和表现假设,为研究空中转移和基于语言条件的无人驾驶航空器控制提供了不同的试验台。 表4概述了用于微调的基准结构。

blocks.en: 5.2 Data splits
blocks.zh: 5.2 数据分割

blocks.en: A single canonical episode-level split is adopted throughout the benchmark. Episodes are partitioned using a fixed random seed and a validation ratio of 15%, yielding 431 training episodes and 76 validation episodes (7,276 train / 1,228 val non-terminal transitions at 1 1 FPS; 73,979 / 13,371 transitions at 10 10 FPS) in the current dataset release. The 431 431 / 76 76 episode partition is shared verbatim by every model at both temporal resolutions, so no validation episode enters any training set at either rate. Splitting is performed at the trajectory level rather than the frame level to eliminate temporal leakage between training and evaluation samples.
blocks.zh: 在整个基准中采用单一的犬科插曲级别分出法. 平生分出使用固定的随机种子和15%的验证比,产生431个训练集和76个验证集(7,276个列车 / 1,228个Val非平生过渡分出1个FPS;73979个/13,371个过渡分出10个FPS分出10个FPS分出). 431 431 / 76 76集分出是每个模式在两个时间分辨率上逐字分享的,因此没有验证集以任一速率进入任何训练集. 在轨迹层面而不是框架层面进行分解,以消除培训和评价样本之间的时间渗漏。

blocks.en: 5.3 Training protocol
blocks.zh: 5.3 培训协议

blocks.en: All models are initialized from publicly released checkpoints and fine-tuned exclusively on WareFly-VLA training data. Whenever possible, official implementations and recommended training procedures provided by the original authors are adopted to minimize implementation-specific bias.
blocks.zh: 所有模式都从公开开放的检查站入手,并对WareFly-VLA培训数据进行微调。 尽可能采用原作者提供的正式执行和建议的培训程序,以尽量减少具体执行的偏见。

blocks.en: Input observations consist of a single RGB image and its associated language instruction. Images are resized to the native input resolution expected by each architecture. For models whose native action spaces differ from the four-dimensional UAV control representation used in WareFly-VLA, compatibility mappings are applied while preserving the semantic meaning of the original control commands.
blocks.zh: 输入观测由单一的RGB图像及其相关的语言指令组成. 图像被调整为每个架构所期望的本地输入分辨率. 对于其本土动作空间与WareFly-VLA中使用的四维UAV控制表示不同的模型,在保留原始控制指令的语义含义的同时,应用了相容性映射.

blocks.en: No test-time augmentation is employed. Unless otherwise stated, all reported results correspond to a single forward pass per validation sample.
blocks.zh: 没有使用试验时间加固。 除非另有说明,所有报告的结果均符合每个验证样本的单一前行通行证。

blocks.en: 6.2 Generalization gap
blocks.zh: 6.2 普遍性差距

blocks.en: The gap between training-set and held-out accuracy is the single most informative statistic in this benchmark and it is large for every model. Table 2 ( D ) quantifies it: on Δ ​ x ℓ \Delta x_{\ell} , SmolVLA’s MAE rises from 0.083 0.083 (train) to 0.468 0.468 (val), a 5.6 × 5.6\times degradation; π 0 \pi_{0} rises from 0.150 0.150 to 0.413 0.413 ( 2.8 × 2.8\times ); OpenVLA from 0.472 0.472 to 0.620 0.620 ( 1.3 × 1.3\times ). Two patterns emerge. First, the smaller flow-matching model overfits the hardest: SmolVLA achieves the best training fit of any model yet generalizes worse than the 7 × 7\times -larger π 0 \pi_{0} , so its capacity is spent memorizing the 431 431 training episodes rather than acquiring a transferable visuomotor mapping. Second, OpenVLA exhibits the smallest relative gap only because it underfits even the training data, a direct consequence of quantizing a continuous, heavy-tailed action distribution into 256 256 bins. This train/val gap is precisely the quantity that train-on-everything evaluation protocols hide; under the leakage-free split it becomes the defining challenge of the benchmark.

blocks.en: 7.1 Cost–accuracy frontier
blocks.zh: 第7.1条 成本精确边界

blocks.en: Fig. 13 positions each model on a two-dimensional chart of parameter count (log scale) and mean validation MAE (symmetric log), with marker area encoding fine-tuning wall-clock time on a single H100 80 80 GB GPU. The Pareto frontier is defined by exactly two models: SmolVLA (smallest at 450 450 M and fastest to fine-tune) and π 0 \pi_{0} (most accurate on the held-out split). The choice between them is a genuine cost–accuracy trade-off rather than a domination: SmolVLA is 7 × 7\times smaller and trains in a fraction of the time, while π 0 \pi_{0} buys the best held-out correlation on the two learnable dimensions at 7 × 7\times the parameter count. OpenVLA-7B is dominated 17 × 17\times larger than SmolVLA, slower to fine-tune and less accurate on every dimension and GR00T, comparable in size to π 0 \pi_{0} , fails catastrophically. The actionable recommendation is therefore nuanced: under a tight compute budget SmolVLA is the rational default, but when held-out fidelity matters π 0 \pi_{0} is preferable; critically, neither reaches deployable accuracy on this benchmark, which remains open.

blocks.en: The benchmark reveals three consistent characteristics of current Vision–Language–Action policies. First, flow-matching policies ( π 0 \pi_{0} and SmolVLA) consistently outperform the discrete-token formulation adopted by OpenVLA. This advantage is primarily attributed to the continuous nature of flow matching, which avoids the quantization error introduced by discretizing low-amplitude UAV actions. The effect is particularly evident for the altitude and heading channels, where the empirical action range is considerably smaller than the discretization resolution. These observations are consistent with recent studies advocating continuous action representations for embodied control [ 26 , 40 ] ; inference-time steering of pre-trained VLAs [ 29 ] is a complementary route to narrowing the held-out gap on small aerial corpora without additional fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 该基准揭示了当前愿景-语言-行动政策的三个一致特征。 首先,流相匹配政策( 0\pi_{0}和 SmolVLA)一贯超过OpenVLA采用的离散式配方。 这一优势主要被归因于流相匹配的持续性,这避免了由光碟化低空无人驾驶飞行器动作所引入的量化错误. 其影响对于高度和航向通道特别明显,那里的经验动作范围远小于光碟化分辨率. 这些观测结果与最近提出的研究是一致的,这些研究主张持续行动说明体现的控制[26,40];对经过预先训练的VLA的推论时间指导[29]是缩小小型航空公司上被搁置的缺口,而无需再作进一步的微调的补充途径.

blocks.en: Second, the benchmark exposes an inherent limitation of single-frame aerial perception. While forward motion ( Δ ​ x \Delta x ) can be estimated from instantaneous visual cues such as target scale and relative position, lateral ( Δ ​ y \Delta y ) and vertical ( Δ ​ z \Delta z ) corrections depend largely on temporal information describing target motion. Consequently, all evaluated policies exhibit near-zero correlation on these channels, indicating that the bottleneck arises primarily from limited temporal observability rather than insufficient model capacity.
blocks.zh: 第二,基准暴露出单一机身空中感知的内在局限性. 虽然前进运动(XX \ Delta x)可以从瞬间视觉提示如目标尺度和相对位置来估计,但横向运动(QQ y\Delta y)和垂直运动(XX z\Delta z)的校正主要取决于描述目标运动的时间信息. 因此,所有经过评价的政策在这些渠道上都显示出接近于零的关联性,这表明瓶颈主要出自于有限的时间可观察性,而不是模型能力不足。

blocks.en: Finally, evaluation across different sampling rates demonstrates that per-step MAE alone is sensitive to frame rate. Increasing the sampling frequency reduces the magnitude of ground-truth actions, allowing even a constant-mean predictor to achieve deceptively low absolute error. Correlation, in contrast, remains comparatively stable because it measures agreement in temporal dynamics rather than action magnitude. These observations suggest that future aerial VLA benchmarks should complement per-step MAE with correlation-based measures, normalized skill scores, and closed-loop trajectory evaluation to provide a more comprehensive assessment of policy performance.
blocks.zh: 最后,对不同采样率的评价表明,单是每一步的MAE对帧率很敏感。 提高采样频率会降低地上真实行动的规模,甚至使一个常数预测器能够实现欺骗性低的绝对误差. 相反,关联性仍然相对稳定,因为它衡量的是时间动态而不是行动规模的一致。 这些观察表明,今后的空中飞行飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行器飞行

blocks.en: 8.1 World-model roadmap enabled by WareFly-VLA
blocks.zh: 8.1 由WareFly-VLA启用的世界示范路线图

blocks.en: Our results expose a structural limit of reactive VLA policies. A single frame does not reveal relative motion, so the lateral and vertical channels remain at chance. World models target this limit directly. They maintain an internal state that summarizes past observations, predict how this state evolves under candidate actions and thereby support planning before acting [ 17 , 28 ] . WareFly-VLA aligns five synchronized supervision streams for this purpose: RGB video, appearance-grounded instructions, continuous 4 4 -DoF actions, ground-truth pose and difficulty tags. Fig. 17 organizes the resulting research space as a directed graph around the dataset core, with eight dependency edges ( E ​ 1 E1 – E ​ 8 E8 ) grouped into supervision ( E ​ 1 E1 – E ​ 3 E3 ), prediction–planning fusion ( E ​ 4 E4 – E ​ 6 E6 ) and a closed deployment loop ( E ​ 7 E7 – E ​ 8 E8 ). We highlight five directions.
blocks.zh: 我们的成果暴露了反动的VLA政策的结构限制. 单帧不显示相对运动,所以平相和垂直的通道仍然处于偶然状态. 世界模型直接针对这个极限. 他们保持内部状态,总结了以往的观察,预测了在候选人行动下这一状态如何演变,从而支持在行动前进行规划[17,28]. WareFly-VLA为此对接了5个同步监督流:RGB视频,外观定位指令,连续4 4 - DoF动作,地地真姿势和难度标记. 图17将由此形成的研究空间作为围绕数据集核心的定向图来组织,8个依赖边(E 1 E1 – E 8 E8)被分组为监督(E 1 E1 – E 3 E3),预测-规划聚变(E 4 E4 – E 6 E6)和闭合部署环(E 7 E7 – E 8 E8). 我们强调五个方向。

blocks.en: (1) JEPA-style predictive representation ( E ​ 1 E1 , E ​ 4 E4 ). Joint-embedding predictive architectures learn a latent state z t z_{t} by predicting embeddings of future observations rather than pixels [ 28 , 2 , 4 , 3 ] . This objective discards warehouse texture and retains task-relevant factors such as target identity and relative geometry. The obstructed and find tags provide direct probes of identity persistence under occlusion, the failure case that most affects person-following.
blocks.zh: (1) JEPA风格的预测性表述(E1 E1,E4 E4 .). 通过预测未来观测的嵌入而不是像素[28, 2, 4, 3], 联合嵌入的预测结构可以学习潜在的状态 z t z t]. 这个目标抛弃了仓库纹理,并保留了目标身份和相对几何等与任务相关的因素. 被阻碍和发现的标记直接探测了在被隔离下的身份持久性,这是对跟踪人员影响最大的故障。

blocks.en: (2) Action-conditioned latent dynamics ( E ​ 2 E2 , E ​ 5 E5 ). The synchronized action–pose stream supports learning a latent flight-dynamics model p ⁡ ( z t + 1 ∣ z t , 𝐚 t , ℓ ) p(z_{t+1}\mid z_{t},\mathbf{a}_{t},\ell) conditioned on the instruction ℓ \ell [ 19 , 21 ] . Ground-truth pose gives a physical consistency check: imagined rollouts must agree with true ego-motion. Such a model recovers target-relative velocity from temporal context, which is exactly the information the single-frame bottleneck removes. Action-conditioned video generation offers a complementary, pixel-space route to the same capability [ 9 , 22 ] .
blocks.zh: (2) 有行动条件的潜在动态(E2 E2、E5 E5 .)。 同步动作 –pose stream 支持学习一个潜伏的飞行动力学模型 p → (z t + 1 → z t, a t , l ) p (z + 1 + 1 → mid z_{t },\ mathbf{ a}_{t },\ell) 以 指令 l\ell [19, 21] 为条件. 地面真实的姿势提供了一个物理一致性的检查:想象中的推出必须与真正的自负运动一致。 这种模型从时间背景中恢复目标相对速度,这正是单一框架瓶颈去除的信息. 具备动作条件的视频生成提供了一条互补的,像素空间的路由,达到同样的容量[9,22].

blocks.en: (3) Language-conditioned prediction and reasoning ( E ​ 3 E3 , E ​ 6 E6 ). Instructions in WareFly-VLA constrain who to follow, not where to go. A predictive model can treat them as constraints on future states: which worker will match the description and where that worker will be. Concrete subtasks include phase prediction over the search–acquire–follow structure of Fig. 1 and counterfactual target hypotheses during active search [ 44 , 34 ] .
blocks.zh: (3)语言条件预测和推理(E3 E3,E6 E6. "WareFly-VLA"中的指示制约了谁要跟随,而不是去向. 一个预测模型可以把它们当作对未来状态的限制:哪个工人将符合描述,该工人将在哪里。 具体子任务包括:对Fig 1的搜索-获取-跟踪结构的相位预测和在主动搜索过程中的反事实目标假设[44,34].

blocks.en: (4) Model-based planning and policy synthesis ( E ​ 5 E5 – E ​ 7 E7 ). Given a latent dynamics model, the UAV can score candidate action sequences before executing them, through latent model-predictive control or imagination-based learning [ 18 , 20 ] . Recent self-supervised video world models already support such zero-shot robot planning [ 1 ] . Planned behaviors can then be distilled into fast flow-matching heads such as π 0 \pi_{0} and SmolVLA [ 5 , 43 ] , so deployment stays within the latency budgets of Section 7.2 .
blocks.zh: (4)基于模型的规划和政策综合(E5 E5–E7 E7. 鉴于潜在的动态模型,无人驾驶飞行器在执行候选动作序列之前,可以通过潜在的模型预测控制或以想象为基础的学习[18,20]进行评分。 近期自控视频世界模式已经支持了这种零镜头机器人规划[1]. 计划的行为然后可以被分解成快流相配头,如-π0\pi_{0}和 SmolVLA [5,43],所以部署在7.2节的延迟预算范围内.

blocks.en: (5) Physical AI and sim-to-real transfer ( E ​ 7 E7 , E ​ 8 E8 ). The corpus is generated under the physics stack of Isaac Sim and Pegasus [ 36 , 23 ] , so learned dynamics inherit a calibrated simulator prior. Domain randomization and world-foundation-model scene augmentation can widen the visual and physical distribution [ 45 , 37 ] , while agile-flight results show that simulation-trained aerial policies can reach real hardware [ 24 ] . Deployment failures return to the data core as new episodes ( E ​ 8 E8 ), closing the loop.
blocks.zh: (5)物理AI和sim-to-real transfer (E 7 E7, E 8 E8 .). 生物体由艾萨克·西姆和佩加萨斯[36,23]的物理堆积所产生,所以所学的动力学继承了前作的校正模拟器. 域随机化和世界发现-模型场景增强可以扩大视觉和物理分布[45,37],而敏捷飞行的结果表明,模拟训练的航空政策可以达到真正的硬件[24]. 部署失败作为新集(E8 E8 )返回到数据核心,关闭了循环.

blocks.en: Each direction is testable with hooks already in the release: occlusion-recovery rate on tagged episodes, rollout drift (ADE/FDE, Table 8 ). The roadmap thus turns WareFly-VLA from a benchmark of reactive policies into a substrate for predictive, physically grounded aerial embodied intelligence.
blocks.zh: 每个方向都可用已放入的钩子测试:被标记的发片地上的隔离-回收率、推出漂移(ADE/FDE,表8)。 因此,路线图将WareFly-VLA从被动政策基准转变为预测性、实体化的航空内含情报的底物。

blocks.en: 8.2 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8.2 限制

blocks.en: Four limitations bound the scope of our conclusions. Open-loop evaluation: every policy is scored per step against the ground-truth frame rather than the frame its own past actions would induce; closed-loop deployment in simulation or on hardware an essential follow-up is expected to amplify the reported gaps, since compounding drift penalizes weaker predictors super-linearly. Dataset scale: the corpus is 507 507 teleoperated episodes ( 8,504 8{,}504 non-terminal transitions), small by manipulation-VLA standards; this deliberately trades raw count for task fidelity and linguistic diversity, so absolute saturation will require larger collections. Single environment and simulation: all episodes come from one photorealistic Isaac Sim warehouse, so cross-environment and sim-to-real transfer are not assessed here; a second-warehouse extension is in progress. Single-frame, single-camera observation: our protocol uses one forward-facing RGB stream, which is precisely what bottlenecks the off-axis channels analysed above; multi-frame, multi-view or RGB-D inputs are a natural extension and would also admit backbones designed for richer observations ( e.g. , RDT-1B’s two-camera setup [ 31 ] ).
blocks.zh: 我们结论的范围有四个限制。 开放启动评价:每项政策每步都比照地面真实框架而不是其自身过去行动框架得分;在模拟或硬件上进行封闭启动部署,预计基本后续行动将扩大所报告的差距,因为增加漂移会超线性地惩罚较弱的预测器。 数据集尺度:本体为507 507个电传操作集(8,504个8{,}504个非地心过渡集),由操控-VLA标准而小;这种刻意用原始计数来交换任务忠诚和语言多样性,因此绝对饱和需要更大的收录. 单一环境和模拟:所有的事件都来自一个光现实主义的Isaac Sim仓库,因此在此不评估跨环境和sim-to-real的传输;第二仓库扩展正在进行中. 单帧,单相机观测:我们的协议使用一个前向的RGB流,这正是上文分析的离轴通道的瓶颈;多帧,多视图或RGB-D输入是自然延伸,也会接纳为更丰富的观测而设计的骨干(例如RDT-1B的双相机设置[31]).

blocks.en: The study yields five findings of broad relevance to the VLA and aerial-robotics communities. First, the task is far from solved. The strongest model, π 0 \pi_{0} , reaches only r ≈ 0.5 r{\approx}0.5 on the forward and heading channels and no model beats a constant-mean baseline on the lateral or vertical channels, which lack single-frame signal. Second, every model shows a large train-to-validation gap and the smallest model overfits most. Held-out capacity, not training fit or size alone, determines the ranking. Third, continuous flow-matching action heads hold a consistent, statistically supported edge over discrete action tokenization, which collapses low-amplitude altitude and yaw commands. Fourth, the GR00T N1.7 new-embodiment interface fails to recalibrate its normalization statistics under limited-data aerial transfer. This failure mode should inform future foundation-model design. Fifth, the architecture ranking holds at both control rates, but per-step MAE loses discriminative power as the frame rate rises. Correlation and closed-loop rollout drift are therefore the rate-robust metrics for deployment-oriented aerial VLA evaluation.
blocks.zh: 这项研究得出了与VLA和航空-机器人社区广泛相关的五个结论。 首先,这项任务远未解决。 最强的型号为 ^0\pi_{0},在前行和航向道上只达到 r → 0.5 r 相差0.5 ,没有任何型号在横向或垂直道上击败一个不变的正向基线,而后者缺乏单帧信号. 第二,每个型号都显示有巨大的列车到验证差距和最小的型号最出格. 被搁置的能力,而不是训练的合适或规模,决定了排名。 第三,连续流相匹配动作头在离散动作符号化上保持一个一致的,统计支持的边缘,这个边缘会崩溃出低照率高度和yaw命令. 第四,GR00T N1.7新版界面未能在有限数据空中传输下重新校正其正常化统计. 这种失败模式应当为今后的地基模型设计提供参考. 第五,建筑排名维持两种控制速率,但每步MAE会随着帧率的上升而失去歧视性力量. 因此,相关和闭路展开漂移是面向部署的VLA空中评价的速率-弹性衡量标准。

blocks.en: Beyond the benchmark, we chart a world-model research roadmap, from JEPA-style predictive representation to Physical-AI transfer, that the dataset’s synchronized supervision streams enable. We release the dataset, baseline implementations and analysis code under an open license. We invite the community to extend the benchmark with additional baselines ( e.g. , OpenVLA-OFT [ 26 ] , π 0 \pi_{0} -FAST [ 40 ] , RDT-1B [ 31 ] and Octo [ 16 ] ), additional warehouse environments and closed-loop hardware deployment. We hope WareFly-VLA catalyzes progress toward safe and capable language-guided aerial autonomy in real industrial environments.

blocks.en: The simulated workers used as targets are dressed from a curated personal-protective-equipment (PPE) inventory designed to maximise lexical grounding diversity while remaining realistic for an industrial-warehouse setting. The inventory is grouped into six categories: 1. Headwear: hard hats (orange, yellow, white, blue, red), bump caps, beanies and uncovered hair (varied colours including the corpus’s red hair mentions). 2. Upper body: high-visibility safety vests (orange, yellow, lime, with and without reflective tape), button-up shirts (long- and short-sleeve, in colours such as terracotta, teal, moss green, lavender, purple), polo shirts and t-shirts. 3. Lower body: cargo trousers, work pants, overalls and coveralls in neutral and high-visibility colours. 4. Footwear: steel-toe work boots and industrial trainers (typically dark brown or black). 5. Hand protection: cut-resistant gloves, leather gloves and ungloved variants. 6. Accessories: ear-protection headphones, dust masks, safety glasses, lanyards and clip-on identification tags. Each episode samples one item from each applicable category, subject to the constraint that no two episodes share an identical configuration. This combinatorial structure is what supports the rich appearance vocabulary documented in the linguistic analysis (Section 4 ) and it is also what makes the find difficulty regime non-trivial: distractor workers in the same scene typically share two or three attribute categories with the target while differing in the remaining ones.

blocks.en: A useful diagnostic for continuous-control policies is how prediction error scales with the ground-truth action magnitude: a policy whose error grows sub-linearly with | a t , d | |a_{t,d}| is more useful for large pursuits than one whose error grows linearly. Fig. 6 bins ground-truth magnitudes into six quantile bins and reports mean validation error (line) and interquartile range (shaded) within each bin, for every model and dimension. On the held-out split, all working models show error that grows with | G ​ T | |GT| on Δ ​ x ℓ \Delta x_{\ell} , the signature of range compression: the policies regress toward the training mean and therefore under-reach the largest expert displacements, so the absolute error is smallest in the low-magnitude bins and largest in the high-magnitude pursuit bins. π 0 \pi_{0} and SmolVLA share this profile with π 0 \pi_{0} slightly flatter (less compression); OpenVLA sits above both with an additional magnitude-independent offset set by its 256 256 -bin quantization grid. GR00T’s error is dimension-uniform and uncorrelated with magnitude. This analysis localizes the dominant error source on the one learnable dimension under-prediction of large displacements and shows it afflicts even the strongest model, underscoring how far the benchmark is from saturation.

blocks.en: D.8 Within-episode error drift
blocks.zh: D.8 周期内误差漂移

blocks.en: A pure per-step open-loop evaluation cannot directly measure compounding drift, but it can probe a weaker proxy: does the policy degrade within an episode as frame index increases? We bin all validation predictions by their normalized position in the parent episode (first decile, second decile, …, last decile) and report mean error per bin. Fig. 9 shows the result: every model’s curve is essentially flat, indicating that errors are uncorrelated with within-episode time. This is consistent with the fact that the trajectories we capture do not contain systematic late-episode events that the policies fail to handle a sanity check for our episode-curation protocol.
blocks.zh: 纯粹的每步开放评价不能直接衡量复合漂移,但可以探测出更弱的代名词:政策是否随着帧指数的上升而在一个插曲内退化? 我们在母集(第一分之十,第二分之十,.,最后十分之十)中按其正常位置将所有验证预测都输入,每分之十报告平均错误. 发相. 9显示结果:每个模型的曲线基本上是平的,表明出错与集内时间无关. 这符合我们所捕捉的轨迹并不包含系统性的后期事件,即政策未能处理我们插曲-校准协议的理智检查.

blocks.zh: D.9 逐一进行质量比较

blocks.en: Fig. 10 overlays all four models’ predictions on the same six validation frames. For each frame we draw the GT in-plane displacement as a solid blue arrow and each model’s prediction as a dashed arrow in the model’s reference color. The π 0 \pi_{0} and SmolVLA arrows align with the GT arrow in direction on most frames but fall short in magnitude, OpenVLA’s arrow is shorter still and biased toward the discretized grid centre and GR00T’s arrow points far off-frame on nearly every sample. The figure makes the dominant held-out error mode directionally correct but magnitude-compressed in-plane predictions visible at the level of single predictions, while GR00T’s gross scale failure is immediately apparent.
